preconditions.description: The number of employees n is between 1 and 3000 inclusive.
The maximum salary D is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The input contains exactly n+1 lines: the first line with n and D, followed by n-1 lines for superiors.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= i for i, p in enumerate(superiors, start=2))
preconditions.description: For each employee i from 2 to n, their direct superior p_i satisfies 1 <= p_i <= i, ensuring a valid tree structure rooted at 1.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the count modulo 10^9 + 7.

The output equals the total number of valid salary assignments modulo 10^9 + 7, where a valid assignment assigns an integer salary s_v in [1, D] to each employee v such that s_v <= s_u for every direct superior u of v.
